item.title: Missouri House candidates in Cole County identify public education funding among top priorities
item.description:
Four candidates are vying for term-limited seats in Missouri's 59th and 60th House Districts. Republican candidate Carrie Tergin and Democratic candidate Becky Kroll are running to take over a seat currently held by term-limited State Rep. Rudi Veit (R-Wardsville). Republican candidate Shane Kampeter and Democratic candidate Suzanne Luther are hoping to succeed State Rep. Dave Griffith (R-Jefferson City), who is also term-limited and not seeking reelection.

Both House District 59 and House District 60 cover part of Cole County, including much of Jefferson City. All four candidates said funding for public education is among their priorities.
